(define (load-config raw)
  (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (list 'defaults))
    (lambda () (if (string? raw) (list 'parsed raw) (error "config is not text" raw)))))
(display (list (load-config "depth=3") (load-config 42)))
(newline)

(define (safe-recip x)
  (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) 'undefined) (lambda () (if (zero? x) (error "no reciprocal of zero") (/ 1 x)))))
(display (map safe-recip (list 4 0 -2)))
(newline)

(define (retry n thunk)
  (if (= n 0) 'gave-up (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (retry (- n 1) thunk)) thunk)))
(define tries 0)
(display (retry 3 (lambda () (set! tries (+ tries 1)) (if (< tries 3) (error "flaky") (list 'ok-after tries)))))
(newline)

(define (first-defined xs f)
  (if (null? xs) 'none (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (first-defined (cdr xs) f)) (lambda () (f (car xs))))))
(display (first-defined (list -4 -1 25) (lambda (x) (if (negative? x) (error "outside domain") (sqrt x)))))
(newline)

(define (guarded-pipeline v stages)
  (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (list 'stopped (error-object-message e)))
    (lambda () (fold (lambda (stage acc) (stage acc)) v stages))))
(display (guarded-pipeline 2 (list (lambda (x) (* x 10)) (lambda (x) (if (> x 15) (error "too big" x) x)))))
(newline)
